scope: Nine named sample points; not a continuous weather grid or a migration forecast.

attribution.name: Data Source: Environment and Climate Change Canada

limitations: No migration score or arrival forecast is calculated.
This file contains forecasts; dated snow analysis and observed cold/river history are bundled separately in conditions.json.
No winds aloft or mapped front product is connected.
NWS gridded pressure was empty in the audited sample; no pressure values are inferred.
Canadian City Page hourly coverage is about 24 hours; missing later days stay unavailable.
ECCC timestamped forecasts are represented as one-hour samples, not provider-defined accumulation intervals.
